name: New starter onboarding (form to folder, tracker, emails, reminders)

parameters.formDescription: Submit this once an offer is accepted. It sets up the folder, checklist, tracker and welcome emails.

parameters.jsCode:
// Edit this block for your organisation. Nothing else needs touching.
return [{ json: {
  orgName: 'Your Organisation',
  parentFolderId: 'PASTE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID_FOR_ONBOARDING_FOLDERS',
  trackerSheetId: 'PASTE_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID_FOR_TRACKER',
  hrEmail: 'hr@example.com',
  itEmail: 'it@example.com',
  guideLink: 'https://example.com/how-we-work',
  // due dates are business days from the start date (negative = before)
  stages: [
    { name: 'Before day 1', offset: -3, tasks: [
      ['Send the welcome message and first-week plan', 'HR', true],
      ['Create email, chat and tool accounts', 'IT', false],
      ['Prepare equipment and workspace', 'IT', false],
      ['Book the first-day meetings', 'Manager', false] ] },
    { name: 'Day 1', offset: 0, tasks: [
      ['Welcome call and team introductions', 'Manager', false],
      ['Check every login works', 'New hire', false],
      ['Read the one-page how-we-work guide', 'New hire', false],
      ['Finish one small first task', 'Buddy', false] ] },
    { name: 'Week 1', offset: 4, tasks: [
      ['Role walkthrough with the written procedures', 'Manager', false],
      ['Shadow a colleague on a real task', 'Buddy', false],
      ['Complete required policy reading', 'New hire', false],
      ['End-of-week check-in: what was unclear?', 'Manager', false] ] },
    { name: 'Day 30', offset: 21, tasks: [
      ['First real deliverable, reviewed with feedback', 'Manager', false],
      ['30-day check-in against the written plan', 'Manager', false],
      ['Give feedback on the onboarding itself', 'New hire', false] ] },
    { name: 'Day 60 to 90', offset: 63, tasks: [
      ['Own one process end to end', 'New hire', false],
      ['Set goals for the next quarter', 'Manager', false],
      ['90-day review', 'Manager', false] ] }
  ],
  // extra tasks added for a department (task, owner, stage index)
  departmentTasks: {
    'Finance': [['Grant finance system access and sign-off limits', 'IT', 0]],
    'Programs': [['Schedule a field visit with a senior colleague', 'Manager', 2]]
  }
}}];

const f = $input.first().json; return [{ json: { to: f.hrEmail, subject: 'Onboarding form needs fixing', html: '

The onboarding form for ' + (f.name || 'a new starter') + ' could not be processed:

    ' + f.problems.map(p => '
  • ' + p + '
    • ').join('') + '

Please resubmit the form.

' } }];
